name: Sagami Ayako
source:
Public health doctor at Kibo Academy.

She has an impudent personality, and for some reason, she and Yuta get along well.

She is not well received by the teaching staff because she is always sloppy, but she is popular among the students.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/teacher/chara.html]official site[/url]]
